title: Evaluating Prompt Injection Robustness of Agent Monitors Across Model Families

original_idea.body:
# Evaluating Prompt Injection Robustness of Agent Monitors Across Model Families

**Problem:** Different LLM families may have systematically different vulnerabilities to prompt injection when used as agent monitors. No cross-family comparison exists.

**Direction:** Use LLMs from three model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma) as 'monitor judges.' Submit identical prompt injection attacks against each monitor. Compare susceptibility rates and characterize family-specific patterns.

**Why it matters:** If certain model families are systematically more vulnerable as monitors, the choice of monitoring model becomes a critical security decision that is currently made without evidence.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 novel bypass vectors; cross-model evaluation methodology.
